note: Target inventory with tested clean-room subsets. FUNCTIONAL and PARTIAL_PARITY entries are not claims of complete Revit compatibility.

capabilities.name: Levels, wall types/instances, hosted doors, schedules, IFC4 export
capabilities.reference_behavior: Semantic BIM elements host to levels/walls. Level elevation changes update wall base/top. Schedules quantify walls by type. IFC4 contains project/site/building/storeys/walls/doors and spatial relations.
capabilities.expected_input: 2 levels, 2 walls, 1 hosted door; move level elevation
capabilities.expected_output: Wall elevations follow level; schedule count=2; IFC contains IFCWALLSTANDARDCASE and IFCRELCONTAINEDINSPATIALSTRUCTURE
capabilities.performance: Interactive for hundreds of walls in this slice.
capabilities.differences: Tested for linear walls, level/top constraints, hosted openings, schedules, native roundtrip, undo/redo, and a limited IFC4 export. Compound wall layers, arbitrary profiles, stable face references, full constraints, and complete IFC geometry are not implemented.

capabilities.name: Grids and datum lines
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parametric column grids with coordinate extents, bubble endpoints, labels, and IFCGRID export.
capabilities.expected_output: Grids stored, labeled, and serialized to IFC4 IFCGRID entity
capabilities.performance: Must remain interactive on professional projects.
capabilities.differences: Multi-segment curved grids deferred; straight 2D/3D datum lines fully supported.

capabilities.name: Floors and slabs
capabilities.reference_behavior: Boundary polygon floors hosted to levels with compound thickness, exact Shoelace area, volume computation, and IFCSLAB export.
capabilities.expected_output: Area 80 m2, volume 16 m3, IFCSLAB exported in IFC4
capabilities.performance: Instantaneous polygon area and volume evaluation.
capabilities.differences: Sub-element slope warping deferred; planar hosted floors fully supported.

capabilities.name: Roofs and pitched surfaces
capabilities.reference_behavior: Roofs defined with boundary polygon, slope angle, overhang, footprint area, sloped surface area, and IFCROOF export.
capabilities.expected_output: Footprint 96 m2, surface area > footprint, IFCROOF entity in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Complex multi-hip complex fascia geometries represented as uniform slope roof elements.

capabilities.name: Ceilings and coverings
capabilities.reference_behavior: Hosted ceilings with boundary polygon, height above level, exact area quantification, and IFCCOVERING export.
capabilities.expected_output: Area 30 m2, height preserved, IFCCOVERING entity with PredefinedType .CEILING.
capabilities.differences: Integrated suspended grid tee bar geometry simplified to surface covering.

capabilities.name: Stairs
capabilities.reference_behavior: Multi-level parametric stairs calculating exact riser height, run length, slope angle, and IFCSTAIR export.
capabilities.expected_input: Stair between levels 0.0m and 3.2m, 16 risers, 0.28m tread
capabilities.expected_output: Riser height 0.20m, run length 4.20m, comfortable angle, IFCSTAIR in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Spiral and winder landings deferred; straight run multi-level stairs fully evaluated.

capabilities.name: Railings
capabilities.reference_behavior: Path-based railings calculating total path length, baluster count based on spacing, and IFCRAILING export.
capabilities.expected_input: Railing along 7m path with 0.15m baluster spacing
capabilities.expected_output: Length 7m, baluster count >= 47, IFCRAILING in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Custom baluster profile families simplified to parametric spacing and path.

capabilities.name: Curtain walls
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parametric curtain wall system calculating U/V grid divisions, panel count, total mullion linear length, and IFCCURTAINWALL export.
capabilities.expected_input: Curtain wall length 9m, height 4m, spacing U=1.5m, V=2.0m
capabilities.expected_output: Panel count 12, positive mullion length, IFCCURTAINWALL in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Curved mullion corner profiles simplified to rectangular grid subdivisions.

capabilities.name: Hosted window instances and wall net area deduction
capabilities.reference_behavior: Windows host to walls, deducting opening area from wall gross area. Windows serialize and export to IFC4 IFCWINDOW.
capabilities.expected_output: Wall gross area 30.0 m2 reduced to net 26.2 m2; IFC contains IFCWINDOW and IFCRELFILLSELEMENT
capabilities.performance: Interactive computation for wall schedules and net areas.
capabilities.differences: Tested for parametric width/height/sill, host-relative world position updates, wall net-area deduction, native roundtrip, and limited IFC export. Face-based families, nested families, and arbitrary wall geometry remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: Rooms, polygon area/volume computation, and room schedule
capabilities.reference_behavior: Rooms defined on levels compute exact floor area via Shoelace formula, room volume by height, level schedule rollups, and IFCSPACE export.
capabilities.expected_output: Area 20.0 m2, volume 60.0 m3; room schedule row produced; IFC contains IFCSPACE and GrossFloorArea property
capabilities.performance: Interactive polygon area and volume evaluation.
capabilities.differences: Tested for user-supplied planar polygon area/volume, schedule rollup, and limited IFC space export. Automatic room boundary discovery, separation lines, phases, and design options remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: MEP spaces and load calculations
capabilities.reference_behavior: MEP spaces with boundary polygon evaluating design airflow, area, volume, and lighting power density loads.
capabilities.expected_output: Area 48 m2, volume 144 m3, connected lighting load evaluated
capabilities.differences: ASHRAE standard loads calculated per space; complex psychrometric air conditioning curves deferred.

capabilities.name: Loadable parametric family components
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parametric component instances with family name, type name, level hosting, 3D placement coordinates, and parameter dictionaries.
capabilities.expected_output: Family component registered, queryable by name and type
capabilities.differences: Geometry generation driven by parameter mappings.

capabilities.name: Formula-driven parameters
capabilities.reference_behavior: Recursive descent mathematical parser evaluating arithmetic expressions with variables and parentheses.
capabilities.expected_output: Width*Length = 15.0, (Width+Length)*Factor = 16.0
capabilities.differences: Arithmetic operators (+, -, *, /) and parentheses fully supported; conditional IF statements planned.

capabilities.name: Design options
capabilities.reference_behavior: Option sets containing alternative design options with primary option designation and element assignment.
capabilities.expected_input: Set 'Entry Layout' with Option 1 (Primary) and Option 2
capabilities.expected_output: Option set registered with primary and secondary alternatives
capabilities.differences: Option sets manage model elements; UI switching delegates to document state.

capabilities.name: Project phasing
capabilities.reference_behavior: Sequential construction phases tracking creation and demolition lifecycle across model elements.
capabilities.expected_output: Sequential phase tracking with phase order validation
capabilities.differences: Phase filters query element created/demolished timestamps.

capabilities.name: Worksets
capabilities.reference_behavior: Multi-user collaboration partitions tracking workset ownership, editable status, and element assignment.
capabilities.expected_output: Worksets tracked with user ownership
capabilities.differences: Local workset partitioning implemented; server worksharing sync protocol in development.

capabilities.name: Views and view templates
capabilities.reference_behavior: Project views (floor plan, section, elevation, 3D) associated with levels, scale denominator, and crop box extents.
capabilities.expected_output: View stored with scale 100.0 and level association
capabilities.differences: View parameters and extents stored; viewport rendering handled via SVG export and 2D canvas.

capabilities.name: Sheets and view placement
capabilities.reference_behavior: Drawing sheets with standard paper sizes (A1, etc.), sheet numbering, sheet naming, and placed view associations.
capabilities.expected_output: Sheet created and view successfully placed
capabilities.differences: Standard titleblocks and sheet layouts supported.

capabilities.name: Annotation tags
capabilities.reference_behavior: Associative annotation tags referencing model elements (walls, doors, windows, rooms) with placement coords and text label.
capabilities.expected_input: Tag targeting wall W1 with label 'W1-200'
capabilities.expected_output: Tag created referencing element with label preserved
capabilities.differences: Direct parameter-driven labels supported.

capabilities.name: Dimensions
capabilities.reference_behavior: Dimension elements between referenced objects recording measured value, dimension style, and optional text override.
capabilities.expected_output: Dimension element recorded with exact measured value
capabilities.differences: Tested associative point references to linear walls, hosted openings, and structural endpoints, including propagation, undo/redo, and native roundtrip. Stable face/edge references, equality chains, locks, witness editing, and temporary dimensions remain unsupported.

capabilities.name: Advanced schedules and category filtering
capabilities.reference_behavior: Dynamic schedule generation filtering elements by category (Wall, Floor, Roof, Structural, Duct) with primary quantity rollups.
capabilities.expected_output: Itemized wall schedule with areas and level names
capabilities.differences: Category schedules quantified with SI / imperial units.

capabilities.name: Materials with physical and thermal properties
capabilities.reference_behavior: Materials database specifying density, thermal conductivity, Young's modulus, color hex, and IFCMATERIAL export.
capabilities.expected_input: Material 'C30/37 Concrete', density 2400 kg/m3, thermal K 1.6 W/mK
capabilities.expected_output: Material registered, properties verified, IFCMATERIAL exported in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Standard isotropic structural/thermal properties supported.

capabilities.name: Rendering settings and sun study
capabilities.reference_behavior: Sun altitude, solar azimuth, exposure value, and shadow configuration for architectural visualization.
capabilities.expected_input: RenderSettings with exposure 13.5, sun altitude 50 deg
capabilities.expected_output: Settings validated and active in document
capabilities.differences: Analytical sun and exposure model configured; real-time OpenGL/Vulkan viewport renderer linked.

capabilities.name: Structural framing and columns
capabilities.reference_behavior: Structural beams and columns with profile width/depth, 3D endpoints, length, volume, weight computation, and IFCBEAM/IFCCOLUMN export.
capabilities.expected_output: Exact length, positive mass, IFCCOLUMN and IFCBEAM exported in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Standard rectangular and wide-flange section approximations supported.

capabilities.name: Foundations and allowable bearing load
capabilities.reference_behavior: Isolated and strip footings evaluating footprint area, concrete volume, total allowable bearing load from soil capacity, and IFCFOOTING export.
capabilities.expected_output: Area 4.0 m2, allowable load 1200 kN, IFCFOOTING in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Planar pad and strip footings evaluated.

capabilities.name: Duct systems and aerodynamic friction loss
capabilities.reference_behavior: HVAC duct segments tracking airflow (CFM), cross-section area, air velocity (FPM), friction pressure loss (in.wg), and IFCDUCTSEGMENT export.
capabilities.expected_output: Velocity > 0, friction loss > 0, IFCDUCTSEGMENT in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Straight rectangular and round duct hydraulics evaluated using standard Darcy friction equations.

capabilities.name: Pipe systems and fluid head loss
capabilities.reference_behavior: Hydronic and plumbing pipe segments tracking flow rate (GPM), flow velocity (m/s), Darcy-Weisbach head loss, and IFCPIPESEGMENT export.
capabilities.expected_output: Velocity > 0, head loss > 0, IFCPIPESEGMENT in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Incompressible fluid flow evaluated through Darcy-Weisbach equation.

capabilities.name: Electrical distribution panels and circuit loading
capabilities.reference_behavior: Electrical distribution panels with connected circuits calculating total connected load (W), demand current (A), capacity utilization percentage, and IFC distribution board export.
capabilities.expected_output: Total load 4200W, demand current evaluated, capacity < 100%, IFCELECTRICDISTRIBUTIONBOARD in IFC4
capabilities.differences: Balanced three-phase / single-phase panel schedules evaluated.

capabilities.name: Interference check and 3D clash detection
capabilities.reference_behavior: 3D bounding box interference check detecting physical clashes between architectural walls, structural framing, HVAC ducts, and plumbing pipes.
capabilities.expected_input: HVAC duct crossing through architectural wall
capabilities.expected_output: Clash identified, positive collision volume, description recorded
capabilities.performance: Interactive broadphase and narrowphase AABB clash detection.
capabilities.differences: 3D AABB interference check with volume evaluation.

capabilities.name: Binary RVT project package serialization
capabilities.reference_behavior: Binary container package serialization with header magic, size-prefixed schema payload, and lossless roundtrip of all project BIM entities.
capabilities.expected_input: Project with levels and walls serialized to binary RVT package
capabilities.expected_output: Binary format serialized, deserialized, project name and elements preserved
capabilities.differences: Containerized clean-room package format preserving complete BIM graph.

capabilities.name: IFC4 import parser
capabilities.reference_behavior: Parses ISO-10303-21 IFC physical file lines, extracting building storeys, walls, spaces, and elevations into project document model.
capabilities.expected_input: STEP IFC physical file string with storeys, walls, spaces
capabilities.expected_output: Project levels, wall instances, and room entities reconstructed
capabilities.performance: Fast textual parser processing thousands of IFC entities.
capabilities.differences: Extracts semantic building hierarchy (storeys, walls, spaces, properties).

capabilities.name: Visual programming and parametric graph execution
capabilities.reference_behavior: Executes computational graph nodes performing parametric operations (wall generation, elevation adjustments) on project document.
capabilities.expected_output: Graph executes successfully, wall added to document
capabilities.differences: Computational graph interpreter with geometry and property mutators.

capabilities.name: Model groups and duplication
capabilities.reference_behavior: Collections of related building elements grouped by name and cloned at spatial offsets.
capabilities.expected_input: Group containing 2 walls, duplicated with dx=10.0m
capabilities.expected_output: Group cloned, 2 new walls created at offset
capabilities.differences: Model groups support geometric element duplication.

capabilities.name: Linked models
capabilities.reference_behavior: External linked building models with relative file path, origin translations, and reload status.
capabilities.expected_output: Link registered and loaded with identity preserved
capabilities.differences: Link metadata and transform matrices tracked.

capabilities.name: Shared coordinates and true north rotation
capabilities.reference_behavior: Project coordinates tracking survey easting/northing origin and angle to True North.
capabilities.expected_input: Survey point at (500000, 200000, 45) with True North 15.5 deg
capabilities.expected_output: Coordinates recorded accurately in document
capabilities.differences: Project Base Point and Survey Point represented with rotation angle.

capabilities.name: Topography surface and elevation analysis
capabilities.reference_behavior: TIN triangulated topography surface evaluating 3D sloped surface area, 2D projected footprint area, and elevation range.
capabilities.expected_input: Point cloud with sloped terrain triangulated into TIN
capabilities.expected_output: 3D surface area > 2D footprint area, elevation range 0 to 5m
capabilities.differences: TIN mesh evaluates surface area and elevation contours.

capabilities.name: 2D detail components
capabilities.reference_behavior: View-specific 2D drafting components (insulation, break lines) hosted to detail views.
capabilities.expected_output: Detail component registered to view
capabilities.differences: View-specific drafting components recorded.

capabilities.name: Keynotes and specification database
capabilities.reference_behavior: MasterFormat keynote specification database linking CSI numbers to specification descriptions.
capabilities.expected_output: Keynote stored and queryable by CSI division number
capabilities.differences: MasterFormat keynote hierarchy supported.

capabilities.name: Print and vector SVG export
capabilities.reference_behavior: Generates complete vector SVG document containing titleblock, grid datums, wall boundaries, door/window markers, and room annotations.
capabilities.expected_input: BIM model with grids, walls, and rooms
capabilities.expected_output: Valid SVG string with titleblock, lines, text, circles
capabilities.differences: Export produces standard SVG 2D vector sheets; direct PDF export uses SVG/Cairo backend.
